title: [FOR SALE] AI stock research platform — screener, AI grading, forecasts, alt data + paid tier and API
author: huzaifazahoor
selftext:
Selling an AI stock market platform I co-founded and built over 2 years. It's live and working, and I'm looking for the right buyer.

**The products:**

* the main platform (free stock research tools)
* the paid subscription tier for portfolio analysis
* the developer API for stock market chatbot

**What it does:**  
Covers 50,000+ assets across the US, UK, Europe, Australia, Asia, plus crypto and commodities. Tools include a stock screener with 80+ filters, our own AI stock grading model, AI forecasts, alternative data (hiring trends, sentiment, job listings), technical indicators, live heatmaps, and earnings and dividend calendars. There's also an AI analyst you can ask questions in plain English.

Pro adds smart alerts, AI newsletters, and portfolio analysis built around the exact stocks a user owns.

**Tech stack:** Django/Python backend, Next.js frontend, Redis, hosted on GCP and AWS, Sentry for monitoring.

**What's included in the sale:**

* Full codebase (backend, frontend, API)
* Established paid API data partnerships
* \~15k in AWS credits + 100k More
* Aged domain with strong history

**Honest note:** traffic is low right now after a recent search algo shift, so it's priced for the tech, the API, and the data deals, not the traffic. If you have your own audience or distribution, it's ready to plug in.

Open to offers. DM me for a demo and real numbers.

comments.author: huppelaap
comments.body: How many paid members do you currently have and can you atleast give a price range. Might be interested but there is so litle info in your post that it now feels your just selking a site, not a working business that generates an income.

replies.author: huzaifazahoor
replies.body:
Fair point, let me give you the real picture.

Being honest with you, this is not a big income business right now, and I won't pretend it is. We launched the paid Pro tier only in July, so it's early. Right now we have one paying Pro member on an annual plan, plus some API usage where people pay us in credits from time to time. So the recurring revenue is small and new.

Where it was a real business is before a Google update hit our site. At that point we were doing around 5k a month on average from ads and subscriptions, with traffic near 800k visitors a month. After the update, traffic and income dropped a lot. So I'm not selling it as a cash machine today, I'm being straight that the earning is low right now.

What makes it worth looking at is the tech and the setup. It's a full AI stock research platform, screener, grading model, forecasts, alt data, and an AI analyst, on a clean stack. We have around 15k in AWS credits now with up to 75k more coming, so hosting is covered for 2 to 3 years, and the data provider only costs about 3.2k a year. The servers already handled 800k a month with no downtime, so there's room to grow.

On price, I don't have a fixed number yet, so I'd like to hear a range from you. If you have your own audience, this is priced for the tech and assets, not the current traffic. Happy to show you a full demo and share real numbers. What range are you thinking?
